text:
Ravi: Quick heads-up — q6b-int4 bringup shows a focused degradation on prompts with embedded CSVs and markdown tables vs fp16 baseline. Dropping repro + a few failing ids.

Marta: please paste the eval command and sample ids so I can reproduce.

Ravi: repro:```
rwt eval --model q6b-int4-v1 --dataset promptbank/tables-2025 --metrics exact_match,bleu --batch 128 --tokenizer split-csv-v2
```
Summary: exact_match 0.61 (fp16 0.68), bleu 0.39 -> 0.44

Evan: tagging curation/label ops. Could be recent anchor-merge + soft-dedupe change (we bumped fuzzy threshold last sprint).

Tess: infra note: no driver/kernel updates in the window. ci-bot: kicked eval job eval-9001, logs: https://ci.internal/evals/9001

Marta: quick per-prompt diffs show failures concentrated on prompts with large quoted CSV blobs and lists of key: value pairs. Token counts skew high (~150-300).

Ravi: examples: id csv-224 delta_em -0.42 tokens 212, id tbl-07 delta_em -0.21 tokens 44, id md-891 delta_em -0.15 tokens 18

labeler-bot: 4 labelers online. Rapid queue: 160. ETA for 100 items ~9h.

Evan: plan proposal:
1) re-run eval with tokenizer=split-csv-v1 (previous) to check tokenizer parity,
2) run q6b-int4-v1 with `--kv-policy preserve-prefix` in case of kv truncation,
3) collect top-150 failing ids, run fuzzy-dedupe --threshold 0.75, flag orphan anchors for micro-golden refresh.

Marta: agree. Also add a quick script to surface tokenization boundaries for failed prompts so labelers can validate splits.

Ravi: starting variant runs. Will add `--preserve-newlines` too for table cases.

ci-bot: Eval jobs started: eval-9002 (tokenizer v1), eval-9003 (kv preserve), logs linked.

Marta: tokenizer v1 run: exact_match 0.66 (closer), bleu 0.43 — partial recovery. kv preserve also helps but small delta remains.

labeler-bot: Update: 4 labelers processed 80/150. Flags: 26 tokenization, 12 formatting, 5 deid leakage, 8 duplicate anchors, remainder model.

Evan: dedupe pass shows ~18 near-duplicates in the top-150, 11 of which are orphan anchors. I'll prepare micro-golden candidate set mg-q6b-tokenfix-2025 with those.

Tess: I can reserve a dedicated dev node for a 4h rescore run starting in 20m.

Ravi: Marta, can you draft a short labeler rubric: check token boundaries, table header hallucination, CSV row truncation, PII leakage? We'll attach to the workspace.

Marta: done. Workspace: rapid-token-diagnose, spreadsheet link uploaded and shared with labelers.

Ravi: holding canary until labeler verdicts + micro-golden rescore. No further rollouts.

Marta: PR incoming to pin tokenizer to split-csv-v1 for q6b-int4 experiments and to add a regression test that asserts per-prompt parity within 2% for table-like prompts.

labeler-bot: Final update (end of triage): 150/150 processed. Totals: 34 tokenization, 18 formatting/table, 6 deid, 20 dupes/orphan, 72 model regressions.

Evan: Given labels: ~34% of failures attributable to tokenization/formatting/dupes. We'll run micro-golden refresh for orphan anchors and rerun full eval. If remaining regressions persist, follow-up is model-quant debugging.

Tess: micro-gold job mg-900 queued. Rescore node reserved. ci-bot: mg-900 logs: https://ci.internal/microgold/900

Ravi: Thanks team. Outcome: blocker on canary. After micro-gold + tokenizer pin we will reassess. Leave thread open for post-rescore numbers. :lock:
